title: auth/oidc: silent RS256 default when JWK has no alg field
description: crates/auth/src/oidc.rs rsa_decoding_key_and_alg() silently defaults to Algorithm::RS256 when JWK has no alg field. This security decision should emit a tracing::debug and have a DECISION comment explaining why RS256 is the correct default for alg-less RSA keys.
